name: Love-Bride Eve
source:
Atsushi and Miyu are childhood friends who are known as the perfect couple by friends and family. They’ve been together since they were small, live next to each other, and are often teased by others for acting like newlyweds. However, there’s one big problem. They’ve never properly confessed to each other. Even though they are so lovey-dovey, it is too embarrassing for them to say those few words, believing that they do not have to say it because they know it deep down. However, Miyu wants to one day have the courage to say the words “I love you”.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/08/01/august-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
敦志和美羽是青梅竹马，在朋友与家人眼中是完美情侣。他们从小就在一起，住在隔壁，又因举止像新婚夫妇而常被取笑。然而有个大问题：他们从未认真向对方告白。明明如此恩爱，却害羞得说不出那几句话，认为彼此心里都明白，无须言明。然而，美羽希望有一天能鼓起勇气说出“我爱你”。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/08/01/august-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
